narrative: On the board. A board across a drum in the tiring-house. Fresh lines, still wet. No speech copied beyond the turn. On the board. The same board. The tune is a thing called for. No names spelled on it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the turn and left the board.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Named on the page as Peter. Not in the frame.

entities.name: Richard Cowley
entities.context: Named among the musicians. Not in the frame.

entities.name: the lovers' play
entities.context: Shown on draft in The board on the drum
